name: mesh-gradient
title: Mesh Gradient
description: Four soft pools of colour drift very slowly over a ground colour and blend where they meet, like a dyed silk or a weather map. CSS only: each pool is a radial gradient moved with transform; no blur filter, no WebGL.

meta.reducedMotion: A designed still: a colour study. The four colours laid out as soft horizontal fields (horizon, body, ground) with a fine grain; not the drift stopped.
meta.useWhen: The palette itself is the brand (a paint, a cosmetics line, a dye house, a weather service), and a calmer, cheaper option than Liquid Field is right.
meta.avoidWhen: As the default "modern" hero background; behind body copy; with more than one other effect on the page; with clashing colours (the overlaps make new ones).
